preconditions.description: The number of cities is between 3 and 500, inclusive.
The number of roads is between 3 and 10,000, inclusive.
The value of importance for each road is between 1 and 100,000, inclusive.
The cities are indexed from 1 to N.
No road connects a city to itself.

postconditions.description: The output is the product of separation values over all unordered pairs of cities modulo 10^9 + 7.
